toolchain.profile: cargo release defaults (opt-level 3, 16 codegen units, no LTO, unwind)

limits: Only symbols whose mangled path names the producing crate are kept; generic code instantiated for other crates is excluded rather than attributed.
A match identifies the crate and confirms the candidate version reproduces that body; it does not prove the whole crate version, features or the node build profile.
Generic code monomorphized inside node crates, and crates that did not build here (alloy, revm, reth, rocksdb and other native dependencies), are not covered.
Relocation fields are masked, not resolved. No first-party component credit.
